<p>Into the Forbidden Zone! Human astronaut Arch is stranded on the Planet of the Apes — but she's not alone, as an alien Yautja warrior is also on the loose! Arch and the hostile apes, led by General Ursus, must form an uneasy alliance to survive the Predator's attacks. And the key to their victory lies in the unlikeliest of places — the Forbidden Zone!</p>
